schedule_c_line.label: Expenses for business use of your home

rules_note: Simplified method: 5 dollars per square foot of the area used regularly and exclusively for the business, up to 300 square feet, for a full year of use (Rev. Proc. 2013-13). Regular method: the business share of the home's costs by area, plus costs for the office alone (Form 8829 Parts I-II). Both readings are shown side by side and line 30 carries neither: the method is the accountant's choice. Depreciation of the home, the income limit and any carryover are listed and never applied. The 2025 simplified rate (5 dollars) and cap (300 square feet) are the figures Rev. Proc. 2013-13 and Publication 587 (2025, for use in preparing 2025 returns, read 2026-10-12) state.
